summary: Frontend-only verification for Silverstone circuit redesign scope completed. Desktop marker click regression is resolved; required desktop/mobile/reduced-motion flows pass.
action_items: No blocking fixes required for this test scope.
Optional: keep desktop E2E assertions tolerant to brief transit/intermediate active states during smooth scroll animation (stabilizes to cars shortly after click).
critical_code_review_comments: Marker accessibility parity is implemented correctly: click and keyboard (Enter/Space) both route via shared activate() path.
Hash routing and viewport state updates are environment/timing-sensitive during animation; final state is correct, but tests should assert settled state instead of immediate state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on public URL. Desktop 1920x1080 standard motion: Hero CTA -> circuit, Cars marker click sets hash #route-cars and reaches cars full-screen; Back to Circuit visible/working; keyboard Enter/Space parity passes. Mobile 390x844 CTA remains visible and reaches circuit. Reduced-motion marker click passes. No horizontal overflow, blank viewport, or runtime error messages detected in tested flows.
rca of the issue: Iteration 24 blocker appears fixed by expanded SVG marker hit target (marker-hit) and pointer-events handling on marker groups. One intermediate run showed transient data-active states during smooth scroll animation, but timing probe confirmed deterministic settle to cars with correct hash/back button shortly after click.
